tasks.task_brief: Create a strong single campaign image for a contemporary Chinese wok-cooking proposition without collapsing to big-title-plus-plate.
tasks.primary_visual_cause: Live wok action is the identity-bearing visual event; everything else explains or extends that event.
tasks.attention_flow: Wok flame/hand motion -> short display headline -> ingredient/process evidence -> small dining-world cue.
4_to_8_high_leverage_controls: Use one dominant asymmetric cooking-action mass rather than a centered plated-food hero.
Maintain at least three conceptual information levels: identity headline, process/ingredient evidence, contextual dining-world cue.
Use two unequal supporting modules that extend the campaign story rather than a symmetric card row.
Derive graphic marks from wok arc, heat path, cutting rhythm or serving motion.
Keep the photographic process credible: natural ingredient variation, restrained oil sheen, clean deep blacks, limited smoke/sparks.
Keep generated typography concept-level and sparse; only a few simple Chinese words need visual priority.
variation_freedoms: Surface palette may be light or dark as composition requires.
Editorial spine, diagonal field, edge bleed and local negative space are free.
Supporting modules may be photographic, graphic or mixed if causally tied to process.
Exact camera angle, crop, vessel and ingredient choice are free.
generic_shortcut_suppressions_max_3: No centered plate hero or big-title-plus-food formula.
No black-gold luxury-food-ad shortcut or excessive cinematic smoke/sparks.
tasks.compiler_output: Compile the family as a process-led asymmetric key visual: cooking action carries identity; three-tier information hierarchy routes the eye; unequal modules provide process and dining context; semantic marks are generated from actual cooking motion; photography is commercial-real rather than synthetic; typography remains sparse and non-brush.
tasks.final_renderer_payload: Create one portrait 2:3 brand key visual for a contemporary Chinese wok-cooking restaurant campaign. This is a distillation-only transfer test: use no reference images and do not imitate any named existing design. Communication job: make live wok action itself the brand identity for the proposition “现烧 / 锅气就是招牌”. Build a materially asymmetric macro composition: one dominant diagonal cooking-action field occupies roughly 55–65% of the canvas; a compact vertical information spine and two unequal contextual modules are embedded around it, not stacked as three horizontal bands. The eye path should move from wok flame/hand motion -> short display headline -> ingredient/process evidence -> small dining-world cue. Express the family through PROCESS_SCENE_HIERARCHY, MULTI_TIER_INFORMATION_SYSTEM, CAMPAIGN_MODULE_LOGIC, SEMANTIC_GRAPHIC_DERIVATION, DINING_WORLD_CONTEXT. Semantic graphic marks must derive from wok arc, heat path, cutting rhythm or serving motion, never arbitrary ornaments. At least three hierarchy levels should be visually obvious even if supporting microcopy is minimal. Photography: credible commercial food/process photography, natural ingredient irregularity, restrained oil sheen, no plastic food, no excessive sparks/smoke; clean deep blacks rather than brown soot. Typography is concept typography only, not production typography: keep visible Chinese copy very limited and legible, prioritizing “现烧” and “锅气就是招牌”; no generic brush calligraphy. Do not use centered plate hero, beige-paper/red-seal ‘new Chinese’ styling, or black-gold luxury food-ad shortcut. The result must feel authored, contemporary, high-end, and structurally distinct from a conventional restaurant poster.

tasks.task_brief: Tell an ingredient provenance/process story whose dominant structure is transformation evidence rather than a conventional restaurant promotion poster.
tasks.primary_visual_cause: Ingredient transformation over time is the visual cause: fresh chili evidence changes through cutting and wok contact.
tasks.attention_flow: Extreme-close fresh ingredient -> unequal sorting/cutting evidence -> wok contact -> small serving/dining consequence.
4_to_8_high_leverage_controls: Use an editorial evidence path with deliberately unequal image masses; avoid a scenic landscape hero.
Make origin/process storytelling dominant through a cause-and-effect sequence.
Use headline, factual annotation and micro process index as three distinct hierarchy levels.
Make supporting modules unequal and meaning-bearing rather than decorative cards.
Derive graphic marks from chili cross-section, stem, seed, cut geometry and heat/time path.
Use premium documentary/editorial food realism: natural texture, moisture, cut edges and plausible wok heat.
variation_freedoms: Background can be bright, neutral or dark if the evidence path stays primary.
DINING_WORLD_CONTEXT may be tiny or nearly absent until the terminal serving cue.
Sequence may run vertical-to-diagonal, diagonal-to-horizontal or another off-center path.
Ingredient scale can shift from macro to process to serving.
generic_shortcut_suppressions_max_3: No mountains, parchment/paper texture or red seals as origin shorthand.
No decorative moodboard collage or symmetric card grid.
tasks.compiler_output: Compile the family as an ingredient-transformation narrative: macro ingredient evidence initiates the story; unequal causal modules show preparation and heat contact; an editorial hierarchy names and annotates the steps; semantic graphics are extracted from ingredient anatomy and process timing; dining context is only the final consequence.
tasks.final_renderer_payload: Create one portrait 2:3 ingredient/origin narrative campaign for a Chinese wok-cooking restaurant, with no reference images. Communication job: tell “一颗辣椒，从采下到下锅” as a provenance/process story rather than a promotion poster. The dominant structure should be an editorial evidence path, not a scenic landscape: begin with an extreme-close fresh chili/ingredient evidence image, travel through two unequal process modules (sorting/cutting and wok contact), and resolve in a small serving/dining consequence. Use a strong off-center vertical-to-diagonal route with deliberately unequal image masses; no symmetric card grid. Express PROCESS_SCENE_HIERARCHY through the transformation sequence, MULTI_TIER_INFORMATION_SYSTEM through headline + factual annotation + micro process index, CAMPAIGN_MODULE_LOGIC through unequal cause-and-effect modules, and SEMANTIC_GRAPHIC_DERIVATION through marks derived from chili cut section, stem, seed, heat/time path. DINING_WORLD_CONTEXT may appear only as a small terminal cue. One primary visual cause: ingredient transformation over time. Photography should look like premium documentary/editorial food photography with natural texture, cut edges, moisture, heat and wok realism; avoid plastic gloss and cinematic particle excess. Keep typography restrained and editorial; visible copy may include “一颗辣椒的鲜度路径” and “采下 / 切开 / 下锅” with minimal factual microcopy. Do not default to mountains, parchment/paper texture or red seals; do not use a centered dish-poster layout; do not turn it into decorative collage. The whole piece must read as one designed narrative system with a different mass structure, negative-space geometry and attention path from T1.

tasks.task_brief: Prove the same family judgment survives severe density reduction and is expressed through spacing, hierarchy and a tiny process anchor.
tasks.primary_visual_cause: A tiny piece of process evidence generates the tension of the whole page.
tasks.attention_flow: Large negative field -> small high-tension process anchor -> restrained display line -> factual line -> tiny process/timing mark.
4_to_8_high_leverage_controls: Reserve at least 65% intentional negative space so absence/spacing carries the family mechanism.
Use one small photographic process/ingredient anchor, never a finished-plate hero.
Retain three hierarchy levels with very little copy: display line, factual line, tiny process index.
Express semantic derivation with one restrained line/mark taken from wok motion or time.
Imply campaign-module logic through anchor/annotation/empty-field relationships instead of cards.
Keep photography precise, tactile and restrained; avoid over-sharpened or synthetic-looking food surfaces.
variation_freedoms: Negative space may be light or dark.
Anchor may sit near an edge, corner, fold line or asymmetrical axis.
Type may be horizontal or vertical if hierarchy remains disciplined.
Graphic mark may be linear, temporal or geometric if derived from process.
generic_shortcut_suppressions_max_3: No beige paper + green calligraphy + red seal formula.
No decorative collage or multiple floating modules.
tasks.compiler_output: Compile the family as a sparse editorial system: most of the frame is deliberate absence; one exact process fragment concentrates PROCESS_SCENE_HIERARCHY; three-tier information remains legible at low density; a single process-derived mark connects image and copy; the page must differ radically from T1/T2 in mass, negative space and attention path.
tasks.final_renderer_payload: Create one portrait 2:3 minimal editorial campaign for the same contemporary Chinese wok-cooking family, with no reference images. Communication job: prove that the family survives severe density reduction. Use a radically sparse macro composition: at least 65% intentional negative space; one small but high-tension photographic anchor showing a precise wok/ingredient/process moment rather than a finished plate; one restrained display line; one secondary factual line; one tiny process index or semantic timing mark. The family mechanism must be expressed through absence, spacing and hierarchy: MULTI_TIER_INFORMATION_SYSTEM remains clear with very little copy; PROCESS_SCENE_HIERARCHY is concentrated in the small anchor; SEMANTIC_GRAPHIC_DERIVATION appears as a single line/mark derived from wok motion or time; CAMPAIGN_MODULE_LOGIC is implied by the relationship between anchor, annotation and empty field, not by adding cards. Primary visual cause: a tiny piece of process evidence generates the entire page tension. Use clean, contemporary editorial photography with precise material realism and restrained contrast. Keep visible Chinese copy minimal, such as “现炒，是看得见的。” plus a tiny time/process note; concept typography only, no brush calligraphy. Do not use beige paper + green calligraphy + red seal, do not use centered plated food, and do not use decorative collage or multiple floating modules. It must be unmistakably different from T1 and T2 in dominant mass, image/type relationship, negative-space geometry, attention path and module architecture, while retaining the same high-level family judgment.
